title: California farmers to destroy 420k peach trees following Del Monte bankruptcy
summary: California farmers plan to destroy 420,000 peach trees following Del Monte's bankruptcy, prompting them to seek USDA aid for financial relief and transition support.
problem_solved: This is agricultural news coverage, not a technical solution. It reports on the economic fallout from a major food company's bankruptcy on local farmers.
why_valuable: It documents the real-world impact of corporate bankruptcy on agricultural communities and government response to farming crises.
